briefs.claim_en: 5G mobile towers spread the coronavirus, causing an increase in COVID-19 cases in areas where 5G technology was installed.
briefs.brief_en: Multiple fact-checking organizations, including Full Fact, AP News, Alt News, FACTLY, AFP Fact Check, and The Quint, have rated as false or incorrect the claim that 5G mobile towers spread the coronavirus or caused an increase in COVID-19 cases. Full Fact stated on March 13, 2020, that there is no evidence 5G is harmful to health. AP News reported that maps do not show a link between coronavirus and 5G. Alt News and FACTLY, in April and May 2021 respectively, debunked claims that 5G radiation or testing caused the second wave of COVID-19 in India. Full Fact also noted on August 26, 2020, that a paper linking 5G and coronavirus was retracted due to lack of evidence. AFP Fact Check, on January 13, 2022, also refuted claims linking COVID-19 to bacteria and 5G technology.
